QuestInfo.0:
[[2016 KMS NY Event]]#b#p9001130##k that appeared in town has a new event every day.
Go talk to Pink Mong.
QuestInfo.1: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]Happy New Every Day!\r\nYou can choose either a Chair Box or Damage Skin Box on Dokidoki Gift Day. Gather 30 each of Happy, New, and Year by hunting monsters around your level.\r#r\r#bMonsters around your level: Monsters that are no more than 10 levels below you or 20 levels above you.#k
QuestInfo.2:
[[2016 KMS NY Event]]Happy New Every Day!
You received a gift from Pink Mong.

0.0: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]Ook! It's the #bHappy New Every Day!#k Event!\r\nA dokidoki gift is prepared today! I, Pink Mong, prepared it!
0.1: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]I gathered pretty chairs and an awesome damage skin. I'll give you one of them as a gift if you help me out.\rOok! How about it? Will you listen to my request? Ook-ook!

yes.0: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]Actually... \rI wanted to send my friends a card as a New Year's greeting.\rBut I was jumping around the trees and dropped the letters Happy New Year I prepared as decorations. The monsters took them all.\r\n
yes.1: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]You don't need to find all of them but just 30 each! I will give you a gift if you bring me #b30 each of Happy, New, and Year#k! \rOh, oh! You can get Happy, New, and Year decorations from #bmonsters around your level#k. Ook!

no.0: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]I'm getting sullen... \rYou'll be blessed in the new year if you help a friend.\rDon't be ashamed and talk to me if you're going to help! Ook.

1.0: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]Ook! You returned! Did you bring all the decorations I asked for?\rLet me see! Happy... New... Year... You got enough of them! \r\nThanks. Now here's your gift. Which one do you want? Choose!

yes.0: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]Check if you got your gift! \rSee you again tomorrow because there's another #bHappy New Every Day!#k Event!

item.0: [[2016 KMS NY Event]]Ook... you need to get 30 each. I have to send cards to many friends.\rYou can bring more than needed but don't be short.\r\n
